The work of Belinfante referred to here actually involves photon polarization correlations rather than the spin correlations which we deal with. However, the two problems are holo- morphic and we present here the arguments couched in spin- y language. We emphasize however the intellectual content of the arguments is credited to Belinfante. In fact we have even trial to use his phraseology where appropriate in order to remain faithful to his logic.
